description: This file contains test cases for handling system signals and process management in the Playwright testing framework. It tests browser closing signals, process signal handling, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: should close the browser when the node process closes
methods.description: Tests that the browser closes when the parent node process terminates.

methods.name: should remove temp dir on process.exit
methods.description: Ensures that temporary directories are cleaned up when the process exits.

methods.name: should report browser close signal 2
methods.description: Checks handling of the browser process when its parent is killed with SIGKILL.

methods.name: should close the browser on SIGINT
methods.description: Verifies that the browser closes properly when receiving SIGINT.

methods.name: should close the browser on SIGTERM
methods.description: Verifies that the browser closes properly when receiving SIGTERM.

methods.name: should close the browser on SIGHUP
methods.description: Verifies that the browser closes properly when receiving SIGHUP.

methods.name: should kill the browser on double SIGINT and remove temp dir
methods.description: Tests that multiple SIGINT signals kill the browser and cleanup occurs.

methods.name: should kill the browser on SIGINT + SIGTERM
methods.description: Ensures correct process termination when signals are received in sequence.

methods.name: should kill the browser on SIGTERM + SIGINT
methods.description: Similar to above, testing process termination with different signal order.

methods.name: should not prevent default SIGTERM handling after browser close
methods.description: Verifies default signal handling is restored after the browser has closed.
